title: Staff-Room Nights at Cut-Off on Rooming-List Group Room Blocks
content:
**Ruling.** At the cut-off release of a Group Room Blocks rooming-list block, staff-room nights count as reserved in addition to the Group Block Rate nights. The staff rooms are the organiser's confirmed Room Reservations naming the block on a rate plan other than the Group Block Rate and guaranteed to the group master account. The staff-room nights follow how the block's staff rooms and its rooming list are guaranteed:

- when there are such staff rooms and **no** confirmed Group Block Rate reservation naming the block is guaranteed by a guest's own card, **all their nights** count as reserved;
- when there are such staff rooms and **at least one** confirmed Group Block Rate reservation naming the block is guaranteed by a guest's own card, **one night per staff room** counts;
- when there are no such staff rooms, none count.

**Records read.** The organiser's Room Reservations naming the block: their status, rate plan, guarantee (group master account or the guest's own card) and nights.

### Combinations

| Staff rooms (confirmed, not Group Block Rate, guaranteed to the master account) | Any confirmed Group Block Rate reservation naming the block on a guest's own card | Staff-room nights counted as reserved |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | all nights of the staff rooms |
| yes | yes | one night per staff room |
| no | — | none |

### Example (hypothetical block)

Three staff rooms of 4 nights each are confirmed on the organiser's profile and guaranteed to the master account. If every confirmed Group Block Rate reservation naming the block is guaranteed to the master account, 12 staff-room nights count as reserved; if one of them is guaranteed by a guest's own card, 3 count.
